recognize_zh: PAX5染色只在散在的小型B細胞核呈強陽性，而大多數核大、淡染的腫瘤細胞為陰性（僅見顆粒狀背景），PAX5陰性可幫忙排除cHL（弱陽性）與B細胞淋巴瘤，支持ALCL。
features: Strong nuclear PAX5 staining in scattered small cells (residual B cells)
Large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei are PAX5-negative
Some positive nuclei in small pairs or clusters
Faint granular cytoplasmic/background staining that should not be interpreted as nuclear positivity
describe_en: PAX5 immunostain shows strong nuclear staining in scattered small reactive B cells, while the large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei are negative, with only faint nonspecific granular background. Absence of PAX5 in the neoplastic cells argues against a B-cell lymphoma and against classic Hodgkin lymphoma, which typically shows weak nuclear PAX5 in HRS cells. Findings support anaplastic large cell lymphoma in this context.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show weak nuclear PAX5 (dimmer than background B cells), whereas ALCL tumor cells are completely PAX5-negative.
DLBCL cells show strong nuclear PAX5 in the large cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is also PAX5/CD20-negative but expresses CD138, MUM1 and is often EBER-positive, not uniform CD30 with T-cell markers.
